fields.description: The Hillgate comprises two Ellington residential towers in Dubai Silicon Oasis, with apartments and limited larger duplex homes. Shared spaces include a music hall, working areas and several pools.

reviewCoverage.identity: Exact Hillgate own project page and branded documents checked. Own body says off-plan; no future completion represented as actual delivery.
reviewCoverage.location: Own body and brochure identify Dubai Silicon Oasis. No coordinates or registry claim assumed.
reviewCoverage.residences: Studio to four-bedroom scope includes two-bedroom plus study and three-/four-bedroom duplexes; not limited to the shorter page summary.
reviewCoverage.areas: Actual 20-page plan pack read, numerical panels10/11/13/17/19 visually inspected for studio, one-, two-, two-plus-study and three-bedroom families. Own branded guide page5 visually verifies duplex area/count rows; individual duplex drawings absent from this retrieved pack.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Own named clubhouse, work/library, Harmonic Hall, children’s spaces, fitness and pools corroborated in branded guide.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Portal exact FAQ1279828 is launch guidance, not guaranteed current available stock. No own current unit-price sheet retrieved.
reviewCoverage.payment: One-page branded payment sheet and guide page14 agree:20+10+10+six5+30=100. Reservation-relative dates differ from construction-triggered instalments; no month inferred.
reviewCoverage.handover: Branded original guide Q42027 corroborates portal December2027. No actual future handover claim. Secondary data aggregators show June2028 registry estimates but underlying regulator record not independently retrieved; confirm contract.
reviewCoverage.documents: Own28-page brochure, broker15-page guide,20-page plans and one-page payment document downloaded. Guide size table and payment plus five numerical drawings visually read. Own October 2026 gallery contains dated images without quantitative certification.

overview: Two towers share leisure facilities, working spaces and a room designed around music and performance.
research.locationNote: Dubai Silicon Oasis, Dubai. Driving times in promotional material are indicative rather than guaranteed.
research.priceNote: Property Finder’s FAQ gives AED 1,279,828, rounded to AED 1.3 million at its headline. This launch reference does not identify a currently available unit or a signed offer.
research.paymentNote: Original branded schedule shown below. Confirm the selected unit’s signed dates and outstanding balance.
research.handoverNote: Q4 2027 / portal December 2027 forecasts differ from a secondary June 2028 registry summary. Confirm contractual delivery; no regulator record was independently reviewed.

facts.label: Project scale
